card: ROLE: Colossal living bio-mechanical vessel built around a central servo-brain; large enough to swallow a metacraft whole
ROLE: Associated with Shabda-Oud forces that threatened the planet Okhar
TRAIT: In the encounter with Othon, direct missile attack on the outer skin proved insufficient; the internal servo-brain is the established critical vulnerability in that encounter
TRAIT: Internal cavity produces corrosive acids that severely damage human lung tissue on passage through the entity
TRAIT: Destruction of the servo-brain triggers a catastrophic internal explosion; the blast was compared to a supernova
TRAIT: Operates as one of a type; at least seven additional units were detected by ultra-radar approaching Okhar at end of the volume, with no further outcome established for those units

RELATIONSHIP: othon-von-salza (Othon von Salza): Othon deliberately piloted his metacraft into the entity's mouth and destroyed its servo-brain from within by firing all weapons simultaneously; the internal acids severely corroded his lungs in the process
BOUNDARY: No known speech or direct communication; no individual motive or autonomous will is established beyond its hostile servo-brain-commanded function
